mentions.name: PlaceKeeper
mentions.description: This app helps small volunteer organizations manage their property and facility records in one place. Users can photograph invoices, forward insurance policies, and log maintenance events like roof inspections, replacing scattered filing cabinets, text threads, and email inboxes that get lost when key volunteers move on. It is a lighter-weight alternative to full CMMS systems for small orgs.
mentions.problem: Small volunteer organizations lose property and facility records when the volunteer treasurer or admin who kept them moves on; existing CMMS tools are too heavy for a small org, and depending on "that one guy" to set up a process is too brittle.
mentions.audience: Small volunteer organizations such as churches managing a building, as well as households wanting to keep property records in one place.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm building a tool that helps small volunteer orgs. manage their property/facility. Something to replace the filing cabinet, text threads and email inboxes that get lost when your volunteer treasurer or retired admin moves on.
